featured_title: How to Read a CDD Budget Before You Buy in Estero FL: 2026 Buyer's Guide
featured_excerpt: Find the CDD named on the tax bill, open its adopted budget, and read the per-unit table, the bond maturity date, and the general fund before you offer. At Copper Oaks in Estero, $936 of a $1,352.67 yearly assessment is bond debt that ends May 1, 2035.
others_caption: Also this week: why Amendment 3 makes December 31, 2026 a date to know for relocating buyers, Marsh Landing's two-board purchase approval, whether your buyer can actually insure your home, what Amendment 3 means for Southwest Florida homeowners, Cascades at Estero after its builder's bankruptcy, Grandezza vs Wildcat Run on which club sets your dues, and Tidewater by Del Webb's occupancy rules.
